data.long_meaning: Mehrin is a name that signifies a person filled with love, kindness, and affection. It is derived from the Persian word 'Mehr', meaning love or affection. The name Mehrin carries the meaning “Filled with love and affection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Urdu. Parents who choose Mehrin usually hope their child will grow to embody filled with love and affection and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehrin total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
